events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: English musician, singer-songwriter, and actor Sting, born Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, celebrates his 75th birthday.

angles.name: Sting's 75th
angles.copy: From The Police frontman to a solo icon, Sting turns 75 today. A true legend whose music spans decades and genres.

events.title: The iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod's influence
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 25 years since the original iPod dropped? It completely changed how we listen to music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day tunes
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Time to crank up those iconic theme tunes. Which Bond song is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's wit
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese. A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album deep dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece – what are your hidden gems from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a legend. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul retrospective
angles.copy: It's been 61 years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them evolve their sound. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically killed on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, born David Robert Jones, was born on January 8, 1947.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the iconic David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today. Forever a Starman.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', was born on January 8, 1935.

angles.name: King's enduring reign
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today. Celebrating the incomparable Elvis Presley and his everlasting impact on music and culture.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English musician, songwriter, and record producer Jimmy Page, best known as the guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Page's guitar mastery
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His guitar work defined an era and inspired millions.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Scottish-British singer and songwriter Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod's raspy charm
angles.copy: Still rocking at 82! Happy birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart. Cheers to a true music icon.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of the band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness! Still bringing the house down after all these years.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Young's soulful voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the soulful voice of Paul Young! Still got that magic.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: American country music legend Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's enduring star
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon of music, philanthropy, and pure joy.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Barlow's pop legacy
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, he's given us countless hits.
